fact_label: PIP extension and cumulative annual cap
value_raw: One 90-day extension (prórroga de permanencia/PTP); 180 days total per calendar year (Jan 1–Dec 31), fixed calendar reset, not a rolling 12-month window
notes: Exits/re-entries do not reset the cumulative count — border runs are structurally pointless past 180 days/year, independent of enforcement mood. Extension cost ~$22-40 (COP 85,000-150,000), ~3 business days processing

fact_label: PPT/ETPV (Venezuelan temporary protection status) converts to permanent residency
date: 2021-03-01 (Decreto 216 de 2021, issued; entered force 2021-06-01, Estatuto Temporal de Proteccion vigencia stated as 10 years from that origin)
notes: The single largest nationality-specific migration program of any candidate in this project, previously entirely unresearched in this file. After 5 years' continuous PPT (Permiso por Proteccion Temporal) possession, or 5 years combined PEP+PPT time, holders become eligible to apply for the Visa R under the ETPV -- a dedicated Resident-visa track for this population. PPT itself currently carries validity through 2031-05-30. Sourced to help.unhcr.org/colombia (directly quoting the statute's own conversion language: 'La tenencia ininterrumpida del PPT durante 5 anos habilita a los titulares para solicitar la Visa R para venezolanos bajo el ETPV'), cross-corroborated by independent legal-registry listings of Decreto 216 de 2021 (Funcion Publica's Gestor Normativo, SUIN-Juriscol, Refworld) agreeing on decree number/date/vigencia. Government domains (cancilleria.gov.co, portal.migracioncolombia.gov.co) returned HTTP 403/thin-render to direct fetch this session -- a real access limitation naming the follow-up owed (primary-text confirmation of the Visa-R article itself), not treated as closed. A separate, narrower Visa V (Visitante Especial) track for pre-Dec-2024 arrivals is explicitly NON-renewable and NOT on this 5-year track -- do not conflate the two when reading this fact. || 2026-07-17 (pass 2): corroboration deepened -- UN Global Compact on Refugees ETPV good-practice page and UN Migration Network ETPV entry (both checked 2026-07-17) independently state the 10-year statute validity and the 5-year uninterrupted PPT -> Visa R eligibility. Confidence stays Medium: five distinct Colombian gov hosts blocked this session (cancilleria 403, migracioncolombia empty JS render, funcionpublica TLS failure, dapre PDF empty render, icbf connection refused) -- second session running, a systematic access pattern; primary-text confirmation of the Visa-R article itself remains an open follow-up.
